scope: Subjective importance ratios, not measured performance or a decision. Weights require one approved comparison per unordered pair. Equal weights are a no-elicitation baseline, not ground truth. CR uses Saaty random indices (n=3–6); 0.10 is only a discussion cue, not a quality certificate. No automatic repairs, rankings of vendors, messages or external changes.
